icon:
Use-case: ads-marketing / fantasy game app icon.
Create one polished original square 1024x1024 full-bleed app icon for the Chinese painterly action adventure game "剑与火：破晓之战" (Sword and Fire: Battle of Daybreak).
One unmistakable heroic medieval longsword, blade pointing upward, forged silver-blue steel with a modest warm brass crossguard and a leather grip. The large blade is wrapped in a sculptural sweep of amber-gold fire with a few deep vermilion tips, like a small rising dawn. Bold elegant silhouette, the sword and flame occupy about 80 percent of the square and remain readable at 48 pixels.
Backdrop: richly painted cool slate/teal mountain stone and distant moss-green valley textures, subtly lit by the warm dawn/fire. Full visual background to every edge, not a plain black/white/transparent background. Old-world oil-painted fantasy realism with tangible brushed metal and restrained luminous embers, premium and tasteful, warm gold against cool slate, not photoreal product photography, not flat vector clip art, not a stock shield logo. The design should feel like an ancient forged relic found in a mountainous European-style fantasy world.
Balanced slightly asymmetric flame, clear straight sword geometry, very few sparks, clean value hierarchy. Keep the entire sword and flame inside an 8 percent safety margin.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no badges, no watermarks, no crowns, no skulls, no dragon, no other brands. Straight square edges, no rounded corners, no border or frame. Opaque background. Deliver only the icon image, no mockup or contact sheet.
cover:
Use-case: ads-marketing / original fantasy game key art, NOT a screenshot.
Create a high-quality wide landscape 16:9 illustration, ideally 2048x1152 pixels, for the Chinese fantasy action adventure "剑与火：破晓之战".
Reference image 1 is our newly made game app icon: use its exact original sword design, silver-blue blade, brass angular crossguard and circular pommel, its amber-gold and vermilion curling fire, painterly texture, cool slate/teal mountains and golden dawn palette. This is a style and object reference, not an image to paste or frame.
Scene: a dramatic yet inviting mountainous old-world valley at first dawn, layered jagged cliffs, misty green pine forests, a winding blue river and a weathered medieval stone bridge leading to a small distant stone settlement with a single ruined watchtower. These should be grounded like a hand-painted adventure world, no skyscrapers or modern objects.
Composition: the large burning sword floats upright on the RIGHT THIRD of the scene just above an ancient rough stone outcrop, fully visible from point to round pommel, same design as the reference. Warm flames coil around its blade and leather grip, with only a few controlled embers. The sword and fire should be the singular foreground subject and recognizable silhouette; no humans or other characters.
Keep the LEFT 45 percent quiet and relatively low contrast: soft slate-blue mountain haze and shadowed forest, enough visual atmosphere but no bright sun, sword, buildings, or major high-contrast forms there. This area is for a professionally typeset Chinese game title to be added later. No actual text in the generated image.
A narrow gold dawn breaks behind the right-hand valley and lights the stone edges and sword. Restrained warm/cool separation, dimensional painterly oil-brush rendering, rich material quality, clear atmospheric depth, refined premium fantasy art rather than oversaturated generic mobile advertising. Detailed but clean, believable weapon geometry, few purposeful forms, no random ornament clutter.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no badges, no watermarks, no UI, no picture frames, no rounded corners, no dragons, no skulls, no extra swords. The full image is scenic artwork to every edge. Deliver one wide illustration only, not a contact sheet.
